UAE Gratuity Calculator

Enter your basic salary, start date and last working day. Your gratuity appears instantly, with each part of the calculation and the article of law behind it.

Prepared and reviewed by the Mustahaqati team · Last updated: 2026-11-03

Calculate your gratuity

Basic salary only, without allowances, as written in your contract.
Deducted from your service, as the law requires.

How UAE gratuity is calculated

  1. Daily wage = monthly basic salary ÷ 30.
  2. First five years: 21 days' wage for each year of service.
  3. After five years: 30 days' wage for each additional year.
  4. Part years are paid pro rata once you complete one year.
  5. Cap: the total may not exceed two years' basic salary.

Example: basic salary AED 8,000 and 7 years of service. Daily wage 266.67. First five years: 5 × 21 = 105 days = AED 28,000. Two more years: 2 × 30 = 60 days = AED 16,000. Total gratuity: AED 44,000.

Resignation and termination

Under the current law the gratuity is the same whether you resign or the employer ends the contract, as long as you have completed one year of continuous service. It is paid within 14 days of the contract ending. Employees dismissed for one of the gross-misconduct cases in Article 44 keep their gratuity under the current law.

Frequently asked questions

Is gratuity calculated on basic or gross salary?

On basic salary only. Allowances such as housing and transport are not included, under Article 51 of Federal Decree-Law No. 33 of 2021.

Do I lose part of my gratuity if I resign?

No. The current law, in force since 2 February 2022, removed the resignation reductions of the old law. An employee who resigns after completing one year of service receives the full gratuity calculated the same way.

What if I worked less than one year?

No gratuity is due before one year of continuous service. After the first year, part years are paid pro rata.

Do unpaid leave days count as service?

No. Days of absence without pay are not counted in the period of service. Enter them in the calculator to deduct them.

When must the employer pay the gratuity?

Within 14 days of the end of the employment contract, together with the employee's other dues.

What is the maximum gratuity?

The total may not exceed two years of basic salary (24 months). An employee reaches this cap after about 25.5 years of service.

Does this apply in DIFC and ADGM?

No. DIFC and ADGM have their own employment laws, and most DIFC employees are covered by the DEWS savings scheme instead of a traditional gratuity. Other free zones such as JAFZA and DMCC follow the federal labour law.

Sources

  • Federal Decree-Law No. 33 of 2021 on the Regulation of Labour Relations — MOHRE (Article 51, Arabic PDF)
  • Emarat Al Youm, citing MOHRE: 21 days for the first five years, 30 days after, 24 months maximum (Arabic, 26 Oct 2026)
  • UAE Government portal — End of service benefits (Arabic)
